serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: RSA® ID Plus for Government, enables the U.S. Federal Government and the public sector organizations to digitally transform, embrace the benefits of modern technologies, and operate nimbly with highly secure and convenient cloud-based identity assurance. Building on the enterprise-grade security that is the hallmark of all RSA® ID Plus for Government solutions, RSA® ID Plus for Government meets the high standards required by the FedRAMP authorization process and is a key component of Zero Trust initiatives. When coupled with RSA's on-prem offering, Federal Agencies can quickly and cost-effectively move to the cloud at their own pace, leveraging existing infrastructure and authentication methods.
